items.title: Si Tak Berarti Level 10000(Sulih Suara)
items.description: Pemilik toko Shen Qingyun tak sadar kekuatannya mampu mengejutkan para kultivator. Dikelilingi orang-orang hebat, ia perlahan naik menjadi sosok legendaris. Saat negeri tanpa dewa, dia mungkin adalah jawabannya.

items.title: System Glitch: Spoiling Married Women(Dubbed)
items.description: Chen Fan transmigrates as a son-in-law in a wealthy family. His wife cheats. Her family humiliates him. Desperate, his "Wife-Doting System" awakens. He discovers a bug: all married women count as wives! He splurges on other men's wives to gain power and builds his empire.

items.title: The Alpha King's Virgin Bride
items.description: The human girl Juno is forced to take her stepsister's place and marry Hunter Vere, the Alpha rumored to have murdered seven previous brides. Trapped in the werewolf world, she struggles to survive and gradually discovers the tenderness and deep affection hidden beneath the Alpha's cold exterior.

items.title: Dia Meninggalkanku? Aku Malah Menikahi CEO(Sulih Suara)
items.description: Li Ping’an bekerja keras demi membiayai kuliah pacarnya, tapi di hari kelulusan, ia dikhianati dan pacarnya bertunangan dengan sahabatnya. Seorang CEO, Gu Liangyue, yang kebetulan melihatnya justru menghargai ketulusannya dan langsung menikahinya.

items.title: Beneath the Forbidden
items.description: Years after losing her child, a woman returns as a nanny to the powerful man who never knew the truth. Now she must face him—and the heir who was stolen from her.

items.title: Sang Ahli Pengawal(Sulih Suara)
items.description: Setelah 10 tahun berlatih, Zhang Shaohu turun gunung mencari cinta. Ia menyelamatkan Direktur Lan Xin, menjadi pengawalnya, dan melindunginya dari pembunuh serta keluarga rival. Ia menggagalkan konspirasi, membangunkan Ibunya, dan meraih cinta sekaligus sukses.

items.title: Triplets: Matchmaking for Mommy
items.description: After a one-night stand with Jack Ashford, Lyra fled and raised their triplets alone. Six years later, her kids seize his diamond ring and launch a daddy hunt straight to Jack, who never stopped searching for her. When the truth unravels, he realizes she has been beside him all along.

items.title: Sang Jenius yang Dikhianati(Sulih Suara)
items.description: Chu Heng, putra kandung keluarga Chu, kembali setelah 18 tahun namun terus diperlakukan rendah. Saat kebangkitannya dirampas oleh anak angkat Chu Ming, ia dijebloskan ke rumah sakit jiwa. Bebas di hari penawaran besar, ia bangkit menuntut balas.

items.title: Rejected as Luna, Rising as Queen
items.description: Alison Gray is Simon's future Luna, but he returns with a pregnant woman, Tessa. Framed for trying to kill Tessa, Alison is publicly whipped. Meanwhile, the Lycan King Sebastian, steps in. Alison sees Simon's betrayal, leaves the pack, and rises to a new throne. Simon loses everything.

items.title: Utang dan Hasrat(Sulih Suara)
items.description: Baru keluar dari penjara, Lin Yeye ingin hidup baru, tapi malah terjebak dalam permainan Jiang Zhou, sang pemberi utang yang memaksanya menggoda kakaknya sendiri, Jiang Yuhua. Namun di tengah rencana itu, Jiang Zhou jatuh cinta padanya dan mulai menyesali tindakannya.
